name: Bhadrak District Civil Hospital
condition_notes: Equipped with 250 beds, ICU, trauma center; basement backup diesel generator needs flood barriers.

name: Dhamra Coastal Primary Emergency Hospital
condition_notes: Very low elevation coastal facility. Highly vulnerable to storm surge inundation.

name: Kendrapara Sub-Divisional Hospital
condition_notes: Main triage zone for surrounding coastal villages; oxygen pipeline secured.

name: Paradip Port Trust Super-Specialty Hospital
condition_notes: Reinforced concrete structure, but port access road frequently floods.

name: Bhitarkanika High-Elevation Cyclone Shelter
condition_notes: Stilt-mounted concrete disaster shelter with solar microgrid, water purification, and rooftop helipad.

name: Chandbali Community Cyclone Shelter #4
condition_notes: Capacity for 3,200 evacuees; designated staging ground for NDRF rescue teams.

name: Rajnagar Multi-Purpose Cyclone Center
condition_notes: Emergency provisions stored for 7 days; SAT-phone link operational.

name: Jagatatsinghpur Coastal Relief Shelter
condition_notes: Inland fallback shelter with high road connectivity.

name: Dhamra Coastal 220kV Grid Substation
condition_notes: Supplies power to 4 coastal districts and port infrastructure; high risk of transformer salt spray & surge flooding.

name: Paradip Thermal & Substation Feeder Hub
condition_notes: Critical power node for petrochemical refineries and water pumps.

name: Bhadrak South 132kV Transmission Node
condition_notes: Secondary transmission line; vulnerable to overhead cable snap in winds >120 km/h.

name: Baitarani River Estuary Mega Bridge
condition_notes: Single primary land evacuation route connecting Dhamra and Bhadrak mainland. Pier scour risk under storm surge.

name: Mahanadi Delta Coastal Viaduct
condition_notes: Carries NH-53 extension. Critical for logistics support to disaster areas.

name: Brahmani River Highway Causeway Bridge
condition_notes: Approach embankments prone to erosion during river swells.

name: SH-9A Coastal Evacuation Expressway
condition_notes: Primary coastal artery. Significant low-lying segments submerge if surge exceeds 1.5m.

name: NH-16 Inland Evacuation Corridor (Sector 4)
condition_notes: Four-lane elevated arterial highway; highly resilient route for heavy relief convoys.

name: Dhamra Port Logistics Access Corridor
condition_notes: Immediate proximity to ocean; high likelihood of total impassability due to surge wash.

name: Kendrapara-Pattamundai Relief Bypass
condition_notes: Two-lane asphalt road; tree-fall clearing equipment pre-positioned.
